author: A survivor's account, set down at the Imperial City
pages:
#The Mirror

Coldharbour looks like home, if home were burned and hollowed and hung on chains. I saw the Imperial City there, or a broken copy of it, with fires in its windows that gave no warmth.

The Prince of Domination drops his anchors from the sky: chains as thick as a ship's hull, ending in black spikes buried in the earth. Where an anchor lands, the realms touch.

I escaped through one of them, at the place where I had arrived. I still hear the chains when it's quiet.
